findings.description: Using sizeof to compute array length only works for true arrays, not pointers.
Incorrect Calculation of Buffer Size — incorrect element count leads to incorrect bounds.
Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer.
Integer Overflow or Wraparound — less likely here, but using int for indices can be problematic with very large arrays; prefer size_t.
